about_the_game:
🚀 Release Date Announced!

ASURA THE STRIKER will launch on April 24, 2025 on Steam.
To celebrate the release, the game will be available at 10% off during launch week!

💥 About This Game

A fast-paced, retro-inspired 3D shooting action game
created as a heartfelt homage to arcade classics from the '80s and '90s.

You are ASURA, a humanoid combat weapon built to eliminate an alien invasion from space.
Master high-speed shooting, powerful melee attacks, and time-bending slow motion mechanics.

  • Energy Shot – your rapid-fire ranged weapon

  • Shining Knuckle – a charged punch for devastating damage

  • Lightning Over Drive – slow down time and control the battlefield

🎮 Core Action Highlights

Wipe out swarms of alien invaders!

Use Lightning Over Drive to escape danger!

.

Destroy powerful enemies with a single punch!

Face off against terrifying alien bosses!

🕹️ Controls

  • Movement: Use the left stick or D-pad.
    (You can toggle whether the character auto-centers when in a neutral position.)

  • Energy Shot: Press the shot button to fire.

  • Shining Knuckle: Hold the punch button, then release to strike.

  • Lightning Over Drive: Press the slow button to slow time (consumes energy gauge).

🧪 About the Developers

LeftOver is a new indie label founded by just two developers.
Everything—from planning, programming, and design, to sound and beyond—
is created entirely by the two of us.

We're taking our time to build something special,
and we truly appreciate your support and wishlist additions!

Minimum:
  • OS: 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-9100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or equivalent (3GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or equivalent (6GB VRAM)

short_description: A fast-paced 3D shooting action game packed with love for classic arcade hits of the '80s and '90s. Control ASURA, a humanoid combat weapon, and unleash shots, charged punches, and slow-motion powers to wipe out waves of alien invaders. Pure arcade intensity!
